nom: Uriage Eau Thermale Moisturizing Face Jelly, Hyaluronic Acid, Fresh Texture

avis.texte: I bought this moisturizing on the recommendation of my dermatologist and I love it!! I found it for better price here than in my country and the shipping was so fast! It came a week earlier. Note**: my dermatologist said is better to use it just at night if you have oily skin. it is really fresh!
Simply amazing face cream, leave my feeling moisturize without being weighed down
Ha sido un cambio grandísimo para mi piel, su textura, su acabado es perfecto y tiene un olor delicioso, súper recomendado
Love this produt, leave you feeling light and hydrated, would repurchase

El paquete vino sellado correctamente, con la debida seguridad y llegó en buen estado hasta Nicaragua. Además, es un producto dermatológico, su calidad es muy buena, con poco producto se puede esparcir en el rostro, así que no se agota fácilmente.

avis.titre: Great perfume-free product for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Great product, moistens your skin without leaving a greasy film. This has no fragrance, which is important to me given my skin type (which tends to get easily irritated with perfumed products). Been using this for a few years, it really does make a difference. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: Hidratante sin dejar pegajosa la piel
avis.texte: Se siente muy hidratante, sin dejar pegajosa la piel, me gustó la sensación

I really love uriage products. It’s the only thing that’s doesn’t break me out. I was a little disappointed how little this was. However, a little goes a long way. We will see how long this last. I wish they made it in a bigger size.
